name: Focus+Context via Opacity Modulation
aliases: Focus+Context via Opacity Modulation (Bruckner et al.)
definition: A technique modifying the compositing scheme to increase transparency of flat regions while preserving local details, based on the idea that highly illuminated regions correspond to flat surfaces facing light sources.
summary: Focus+Context via Opacity Modulation increases transparency in flat, uninteresting regions while preserving local details, solving occlusion without causing disorientation.
